summary_en: LEC expanded its share buyback authorization by 100% to 2 million shares (6.1% of outstanding shares) and 2 billion yen, extending the acquisition period to February 26, 2027. As of October 31, 2026, the company had acquired 869,500 shares for 828 million yen under the previous 1 billion yen frame.
title_en: Notice Regarding Partial Revision of Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Expansion of Acquisition Frame)
translation_en_brief: On November 13, 2026, LEC's board of directors approved an expansion of its treasury stock acquisition program. The maximum number of shares authorized for acquisition was increased from 1 million to 2 million shares, and the budget ceiling was raised from 1 billion yen to 2 billion yen. The acquisition period was also extended from December 8, 2026 to February 26, 2027. All acquisitions will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The 2 million shares represent 6.1% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock held as of October 31, 2026), compared to the previous authorization of 2.97%. The company stated that the expansion is intended to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns while enabling flexible capital policies in response to evolving business conditions. As of October 31, 2026, the company had acquired 869,500 shares for 828 million yen under the original 1 billion yen frame authorized in June 2026.
